label: prop:frobenius-self-duality-forces-lp-dual-extraction
title: Frobenius self-duality of $(H_n(R,q),\tau)$ forces $\tau$-extraction to produce LP-dual variables
html: The Markov trace \tau on H_n(R,q) is a non-degenerate symmetric bilinear pairing. This makes (H_n(R,q),\tau) a Frobenius algebra, hence canonically isomorphic to its R-linear dual. Under this isomorphism, the primal LP variable x \in H_n and the dual LP variable u \in H_n^* live in the same space, and the Observation Frame \mathrm{Obs}_\tau(a) := \tau(a \cdot -) extracts the shadow-price representative of every observable.
heading: Proposition
